text:
alex: Quick async weekly check for microbatch + KV warmup. What I did: landed the prefetch tweak that drops max_wait from 12ms -> 6ms on kernel queue and ran a full microbatch perf sweep. Observed ~4% p99 regression on 2k seq path in prod-like bench.

alex: Blockers: can't repro locally with same docker image (config mismatch?). Need someone to look at kernel_tile loop changes that Mia pushed last week.

alex: Today: want to roll a canary disabling prefetch for >=64-token requests and see if p99 returns. PR up: #4821 — need review. ping @mia @sam for eyeballs.

mia: I also saw the p99 blip on the perf-runner traces. Looks correlated with my kernel_tile stride unroll change. Will try a minimal revert and run the same bench.

sam: I can review #4821 in ~2 hours. One quick note on the PR: add a comment about tradeoffs for cold KV misses.

jen: Can you paste the exact bench command you used? Also can we tag the run with seq=2048 so perf dashboards filter correctly?

alex: bench command I used: `./tools/bench --model gpt-j-8k --seq 2048 --batch 8 --warmup 200 --measure p50,p90,p99`
Logs: https://gist.github.com/redwood/abcd1234 (contains p50/p90/p99 csv).
Also added routing fallback to int8 if OOMs happen.

ci-bot: Build #4821 passed unit tests. Perf-run queued on perf-runner-3.

diego: Re: KV eviction spike — noticed a similar pattern last month at 04:00 UTC after GC. Quick patch I used last time: prefetch-on-miss + increment hot_score to avoid immediate eviction. Snippet:
```json
{"kv": {"prefetch_on_miss": true, "hot_score_inc": 3, "ttl_secs": 1800}}
```
That lowered eviction rate but increased mem by ~120MB on slot-7. Worth testing on canary.

alex: Thanks @diego. Mia — I'll hold the canary until you push revert or we A/B. Sam if you can review then I'll schedule canary 30m after merge.

mia: Pushed a minimal revert of the unroll (PR #4835). Quick bench locally shows p99 back to baseline. Also added a unit test for kernel_tile stride to avoid regressions.

sam: Reviewed #4821 and approved, left one nit on the doc string.

alex: Rolling canary now (will disable prefetch for >=64 tokens as in the PR). Monitor these dashboards: /dash/perf/kernels and /dash/kv/hits. Alert conditions: p99 > baseline + 5% or eviction_rate > 0.02.

ci-bot: Canary started on cluster slot-7 at 1971234575. Canary group: 5% traffic.

jen: FYI I'll be AFK for ~2 hours. If canary needs rollback, please ping @sam.

alex: Noted — thanks team :thumbsup: :rocket:

sam: Monitoring logs now, will post quick updates if anything spikes.

alex: If canary is green in 30m we merge and schedule full rollout. If not, rollback and we iterate on kernel_tile revert + KV tweaks.

mia: Thanks all, I'll follow up with a short postmortem if the revert was necessary.
